$comment: p15-oracle-094: e2e scripts 23-33 of MQ-e2e (`ls scripts/cmux-next/*-e2e.py scripts/cmux-next/*-e2e.sh`, sorted). Each script stays and is linked here to its case, or excluded with a reason. `fix` is the commit that made the behavior the script checks, `parent` that commit's parent: the case's acceptance is a Failure on `parent`. `catches` says which case step or invariant shows the bug there; `excluded` names a script no case can convert yet, with the reason, and its `gap` names the follow-up and its owner task; such a script is not counted as converted. `gap` on a converted script names what its case leaves out. oracle.py skips `_` files; one file per batch, so the batches (092-097) never edit the same file.

scripts/cmux-next/home-tabs-stay-e2e.py.catches: merge-home-out and merge-into-home: on the parent the merge runs (ok, not control.unavailable) and Home's tabs move

scripts/cmux-next/jump-keys-e2e.py.catches: pane-1 and focus-sidebar: on the parent Ctrl-Cmd-1 and Ctrl-Cmd-E run no action, so the receipt check and the focus waits fail

scripts/cmux-next/keyboard-parity-e2e.py.cited: #19870 (Cmd-K searches agent chats outside a terminal)
scripts/cmux-next/keyboard-parity-e2e.py.catches: page-cmd-k: on the parent Cmd-K on the New Tab page opens no palette, so its waitFor on /overlays/palette/open times out

scripts/cmux-next/new-kind-tab-e2e.py.catches: new-of-kind: on the parent newTab.ofKind is not an action (control.not_found)

scripts/cmux-next/new-tab-e2e.py.catches: the invariant on the New Tab page's draft at typed: a cold page drops the first keys typed in Cmd-T's turn
scripts/cmux-next/new-tab-e2e.py.gap: the adoption's main-thread time (p95 under 16 ms) is the perf lab's story new-tab-page, not an oracle value

scripts/cmux-next/new-workspace-in-group.catches: the group invariants at top-done and end: on the parent a new workspace lands outside the shown group

scripts/cmux-next/new-workspace-like-thi.catches: like-anchor: on the parent workspace.newLikeThis is not an action (control.not_found)

scripts/cmux-next/new-workspace-real-typ.catches: the draft invariant at after-cmd-n: on the parent the keys typed before the new workspace's page exists are lost
scripts/cmux-next/new-workspace-real-typ.gap: real window-server events at 25-30 keys/s stay in the script; the case types through debug.key

scripts/cmux-next/newtab-chat-header-e2e.catches: plus-1 to plus-4: on the parent about half the [+] clicks leave the New Tab page in the chat's pane, so that round's layout tree keeps its one pane and the wait on /layout/screens/0/root times out; with four rounds in fresh workspaces, as the script runs them, a parent run fails about 15 times in 16

scripts/cmux-next/newtab-key-hold-e2e.py.cited: nightly 2026-10-11 P0 typing ('I cannot type into cmux nightly at all')
scripts/cmux-next/newtab-key-hold-e2e.py.catches: open-and-leave: on the parent the hold never ends, so the terminal's screen does not change within 1 s

scripts/cmux-next/page-popup-escape-e2e..excluded: the bug (cx-6k6cg, #19819; fix e17d3c64ac3d918743c43768f92f3feec663c1c7, parent 6efb6af004cebd3a18d425ae2a1c0dfc052aa9c1) is the composer menu panel's geometry: on the parent it is clipped at the window's edge instead of escaping into a native panel. No snapshot facet records a popup's frame, clipping or native-panel host (the script reads debug.page_popup), so a case could only check that the menu opens and closes, which the parent passes too
scripts/cmux-next/page-popup-escape-e2e..gap: a popup geometry field in the overlays facet (frame, clipped, native-panel hosted) converts this script; owner p15-oracle-038 (Facet: overlays and palette). Its acceptance is controller state only, so the field must come from the popup controller's own record of its panel, not the view tree
